high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "factinfinity." The post features two side-by-side images of foot bones: one on the left appears to be a fossilized or preserved human foot bone encased in a glass block, while the one on the right is a black-and-white X-ray image of a human foot. The text overlay on the image reads: "@factinfinity" "DID YOU KNOW?" "The bone structure of a human foot and an elephant foot." Below the images, there is additional text that says: "41,768 likes" "factinfinity
